rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs approved in content, structure and format by the AMA, AAPA or NCCPA; at least 50 hours Category I
rules.audit_note: Attest by signature on renewal. Keep documentation (e.g. NCCPA CME logging certificate) 4 years after the renewal period; produce on written request.

topics.who: All PAs: Category I controlled substance prescribing incl. Department treatment guidelines on opioids, benzodiazepines, barbiturates and carisoprodol; part of the 100 hours

rules.notes: Hours count over the NCCPA two-year period (certified PAs) or a birth-year-based two-year period (others). Biennial birthdate renewal; plus $10 state regulatory fee.
